headline: CISA adds WordPress Core flaw to KEV with Nov 6 deadline; $6.3B Binance heist coverage grows; Node-RED flaw exploited

bullets.text: New: CISA added WordPress Core CVE-2026-119977, a time-of-check time-of-use race condition, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-03. The federal due date is 2026-11-06. Known ransomware use is listed as unknown.

New: DataBreaches.net reports new statements from the hackers who hit UNM hospital, who apologized and offered patients $2,500. It also reports a second Liverpool hospital investigating staff over a breach of Southport attack patient records.

Still active: the $6.3B Binance heist spans 9 outlets. TechCrunch reports researchers warned of North Korean hacking tactics years earlier, and The Register reports the FBI pins the heist on North Korean hackers.

Still active: The Hacker News says attackers exploit a critical Siemens IoT2050 flaw, CVE-2026-58115, to plant remote command backdoors. Help Net Security reports the same CVE in Node-RED used to deploy a Linux bot and backdoors.

Still active, Connect Secure, 4 outlets: Ivanti patched two more zero-days chained in attacks, CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527. CISA KEV lists CVE-2026-104935 in the same product, with federal due dates of 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-13.

Still active: The Hacker News reports Chainstack disclosed a breach of its production systems that exposed customer data and password hashes. The Register reports mSecure is telling users to change passwords and won't say why.

actions: Update WordPress Core for CVE-2026-119977 per vendor guidance; the KEV federal due date is 2026-11-06.
Find Node-RED instances and Siemens IoT2050 devices, patch CVE-2026-58115 per vendor guidance, and look for backdoors.
Apply Ivanti's latest Connect Secure patches, covering CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527, and check appliances for compromise.
If you use Chainstack or mSecure, change your passwords and follow vendor notices.
Inventory Barracuda devices, check the vendor's advisory for the critical root-access flaws, and apply its fixes.
Patch GitLab CE/EE (CVE-2026-97229) and Cisco ASA/FTD (CVE-2026-76418) now; both KEV due dates have passed.
